rust_summary: a saved player file made for a player who has never played here (`native_create_player_file`).
doc_summary: `native_create_player_file(uuid, name)` makes the saved file of a player who has never played here, with a new player's state (full health and food, no items, no position), so that the inventory helpers can read and change it before they first join; when they join, the file loads as a returning player's. Err `NativeInventoryError` when there is no world, the player is on the server, or a file exists already, or the file cannot be written. Bundles need "hooks": @API:create_player_file@.
